Acme Corp Employee Handbook -- Time Off Policy

All employees must request PTO at least two weeks in advance through the HR portal. Please note that requests during the last two weeks of the quarter require manager pre-approval. Managers are required to approve or deny requests within 3 business days.

Unused PTO does not roll over into the next calendar year.
